fact: On 14 July 2026 the Minister of Digital Transformation inaugurated the Mauritanian Research and Education Network (RIMER), with eduroam deployed at the University of Nouakchott, which is linked to GÉANT via RedIRIS at 1 Gbps.
title: نواكشوط/ تدشين الشبكة الموريتانية للتعليم والبحث العلمي (RIMER)
